periods.time: Opening ceremony day, after Shizuku reunion

name.zh: 史黛菈与珠雫毁坏教室
name.en: Stella and Shizuku Destroy the Classroom

periods.summary: Stella and Shizuku escalate from arguing over Ikki into drawing Devices and wrecking the classroom.
periods.cause: Shizuku openly claims an intimate sibling bond with Ikki while Stella objects and reveals her master-servant relationship with Ikki.
periods.process: Shizuku's jealousy and Stella's pride lead both to summon Yoishigure and Laevateinn. Kagami evacuates classmates before the two attack each other.
periods.outcome: The classroom is destroyed and both top freshmen are punished with one week of in-room suspension.
periods.aftermath: Kagami spreads the incident in a wall newspaper; Stella and Shizuku's rivalry continues into the mall outing.
periods.significance: Establishes Stella and Shizuku as romantic rivals and demonstrates how volatile their feelings for Ikki are.
